reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Inclusive Components (https://inclusive-components.design/).
Technology stack: css, javascript.
Component specification: 最后开 Toggle Buttons。先看到插头标题，往下才是开关怎么做。

Visual details from source observation: 我们进首页，黑底大标题下面写这是一份想当模式库的博客，插头插画排成一排。About 用问答说清：每篇针对一个组件，给出更稳、更能用的版本。我们打开 Toggle Buttons，先对比 checkbox 当开关为什么别扭，再写真正的 button。适合做组件库时对照；纸书是另卖的，博文许可未写明。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
